overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for NLA: course_content, learning_outcomes, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements and assessment are cleanly and completely split, with arbeidskrav correctly kept out of assessment. Remaining problems are a dropped teaching_methods section on nynorsk plans, a boilerplate reading_list and placeholder prerequisites, plus a stray language label.

findings.evidence: Forelesingar, seminar med aktiv studentdeltaking, gruppeseminar, barneskolepraksis og sjølvstudium.
findings.description: The nynorsk plans have a 'Arbeids- og undervisingsformer' section with real content, but no teaching_methods row is emitted; the text is lost entirely (it is not in course_content either).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading pattern in R/section_heading_map.R (or the NLA JSON field mapping) matches 'undervisningsformer' but not the nynorsk spelling 'undervisingsformer' (missing 'n').
findings.suggested_fix: Make the teaching-methods heading pattern tolerant: 'arbeids-? og undervis(n)?ingsformer' (optionally also 'undervisning'), mapped to teaching_methods in R/section_heading_map.R.

findings.evidence: Litteratur og faglige ressurser finner du her.
findings.description: reading_list contains only the generic link label ('Digital litteraturliste'), with no actual literature; the link target is not captured. This is identical text in nearly every course and carries no content. The pre-pass 'boilerplate' flag is a real problem, not a false alarm. Course nla_MGL1NO301... style duplicates also appear (the line repeated twice) in nla_4MGL1NO301-1_2025_autumn_1.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The NLA plan renders the literature list as an external hyperlink; extraction keeps only the anchor text.
findings.suggested_fix: Either capture the href of the 'her' link into reading_list, or drop the row in .clean_sections() when the text matches '^Litteratur og faglige ressurser finner du her\.?$' so it is not emitted as content.

findings.description: prerequisites is a pure cross-reference placeholder ('Se programplan') in most suspects; the pre-pass 'empty' flag is correct in that there is no real prerequisite content, though extraction faithfully mirrors the source.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source plans contain only a pointer to the program plan under 'Forkunnskapskrav'.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat prerequisites matching '^Se programplan\.?$' as empty and do not emit a row in .clean_sections().

findings.evidence:
Bokmål

Individuell muntlig eksamen med forberedelsestid.
findings.description: A stray language label ('Bokmål') from a bilingual text block is captured at the start of assessment (and of course_content in KRLE courses), polluting otherwise correct text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source HTML has language-version labels inside the sections; no cleanup of standalone 'Bokmål'/'Nynorsk' lines.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() remove lines consisting solely of 'Bokmål' or 'Nynorsk'.
